policies.request: Strict pinned vendor schema executed by AJV; original frozen TypeScript schema executed by Zod. No Rust implementation is invoked.
policies.vendorResponse: Unpaired operations use AJV after removing string enum, format, minLength and maxLength keywords and widening additionalProperties:false to true. Numeric minimum/maximum/integer and array minItems/maxItems constraints remain. Discriminated unions retain exactly-one-match oneOf semantics for absent tags; an additional branch preserves objects with an unknown string discriminator.
policies.frozenResponse: Paired operations exclusively use frozen Zod with unknown object fields preserved; enum vocabularies widened only within their original string/number member types and string-literal unions widened to strings; uuid, rfc3339, datetime, date, duration, email, url and regex checks bypassed. Frozen min/max, requiredness, types, nullability, individual literals, catchalls, refinements, defaults and transforms remain. Frozen discriminated unions retain required known-tag dispatch; absent and unknown tags are rejected.
